$comment: Which e2e specs a run started by hand picks (scripts/ci-affected.mjs). A changed module picks the specs of every route whose page imports it, directly or through other modules.

routes: each route (a folder under src/app with a page file, named as the folder is) and the specs that open it, by file name without .spec.ts. 'all' marks a route every spec passes through: Home, where seedSetup ends, and Tips, where it writes the plan (e2e/helpers/seed-setup.ts). A change that reaches one runs every spec.
allOnly: specs that open only routes marked 'all', so they run whenever one of those is reached.
The smoke spec runs with every list and needs no entry. A route with [] has no spec of its own yet: a new spec that opens it is added here, or scripts/ci-affected.test.mjs fails.
The unit tests fail when a route or a spec is missing here, or when this names one that doesn't exist.
